_meta_log.purpose: CORRECTION of earlier US-only SERP claim. User correctly noted US != world and that VN SERP shows Vietnamese brands ranking. This matrix samples VN + US + AU.
_meta_log.note: Full raw payloads saved by harness to tool-results/. Only positions + types extracted here.
_meta_log.key_correction: Earlier doc claimed 'page 1 = all forums/travel, no professional atelier'. That was a US-LOCATION ARTIFACT. From Vietnam, professional ateliers DO rank (local pack + own sites). The white-space claim must be qualified BY LOCATION.

organic_top8.type: ATELIER own site — snippet: 'bespoke Traditional Ao Dai... hand-stitching. Crafted in Saigon'

matrix.verdict: Atelier sites DO rank (Maydo #2, Duan #6) + a 3-pack of real bespoke houses above organic. NOT a forum-only SERP. Competition from real ateliers is REAL here.
From US: NO local pack, mostly forum/UGC/seller; only 1 atelier (Mark&Vy #7). This is the SERP the earlier draft over-generalized from.
VN bridal houses own it: Nicole Bridal ranks with BOTH product page (#1) AND blog (#9). Confirms a VN brand with content can rank. Diaspora US sellers pushed to image block, not organic top.
US diaspora sellers + Amazon. No Saigon atelier, no VN bridal house.
Mix: diaspora sellers + LOCAL AU Vietnamese bridal (Le Vow, Ao Dai Sydney) + social. No Saigon atelier — but local-AU competitors exist.

synthesis.vietnam_serp: Professional ateliers + local pack DO rank. Maison competes against real Saigon houses (Maydo, Duan, Minh Chau, Kim Bespoke, Nicole Bridal) — NOT empty space. Differentiation must be brand/heritage/editorial depth + Google Business Profile (for the local pack).
synthesis.us_au_serp: Owned by diaspora sellers + marketplaces + (AU) local Vietnamese-bridal shops. Maison's 'made in Saigon bespoke' angle is genuinely uncontested THERE, but must reach those users via content that ranks in US/AU — harder for a brand-new VN domain.
synthesis.implication: White space is LOCATION-DEPENDENT: weakest competition for Maison's exact positioning is the US/AU diaspora SERP (no real Saigon atelier there); but the easiest-to-win + highest-intent traffic (people physically in/coming to Saigon) is the VN SERP, where competition from real ateliers is strong and a Google Business Profile + reviews matter as much as blog content.
